paragraphs: Rabbi Yonatan ben Ḥarsha, a man of Gonsar.

Hyman cites Jerusalem Talmud Maaserot 1:2 with Rabbi Assi saying that Yonatan ben Charsha of Ginsar asked Rabban Gamliel and the sages at Yavneh. He gives Rabbi Yose as the transmitter in Tosefta Kelim, Bava Batra 5:2, and reports that Zuckermandel’s Tosefta agrees with the Gemara.

notes.text: Bava Batra here is the last of Tosefta Kelim’s divisions, not the civil-law tractate. Gonsar/Ginsar and Assi/Yose are the differences Hyman records.

The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 1:2 reads Rabbi Yose, rather than Hyman’s Rabbi Assi. Zuckermandel’s exact Tosefta reading was not independently inspected here and remains Hyman’s report. The variant transmitters are not harmonized.
